en: Colored vintage postcard view taken from the sea, showing the harbor and waterfront of a historic city with sailing ships and early steam vessels in the foreground. Behind the port rises a densely built hillside crowned by a large fortress-like complex. The image is framed with a cream border and has printed red text at the bottom identifying the view, plus small red vertical printing along the left edge.
